mesajlar.mesaj:
Merhaba Minister Renegrade,

It is a true pleasure to receive your letter, and I warmly welcome Glasgow’s initiative to forge closer commercial ties with Sussex. We would be delighted to establish a steady, friendly, and mutually prosperous trade bridge between our two realms.

Sussex is blessed with substantial resource reserves—particularly our mineral and quarry outputs—and we are well-positioned to support Glasgow's needs:

- Iron Ore: Sussex holds strong, reliable stores of high-grade ore. We can comfortably supply up to 1,000 ounces of iron ore at £19.50 per ounce.
- Tons of Stone: Our quarries are running with abundant capacity. We can provide stone in virtually whatever quantity your county requires at £14.00 per ton.
- Bushels of Wood: We can allocate up to 750 bushels of timber at £4.50 per bushel.

Regarding clay, our stockpiles have recently been heavily drawn down for domestic infrastructure and municipal projects, so we are unfortunately unable to export clay bars at this time.

Glasgow's maritime logistics, supported by dedicated trade vessels, make this partnership wonderfully seamless for both sides.

Please let me know the exact volumes you wish to lock in, and I will immediately prepare the official grants and ready our warehouses for your fleet's arrival. I truly look forward to our cooperation.

With warmest regards and respect,


Trade Minister of Sussex
